# Copilot Instructions for Donation Management System

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

## Project Overview

This is a donation management system built with:
- **Frontend**: React + TypeScript + Redux Toolkit + Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: .NET Core Web API

## Key Features
- Donor registration and management
- Donation processing and tracking
- Campaign management
- Analytics dashboard
- Admin panel with role-based access

## Coding Standards

### Frontend (React + TypeScript)
- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Use Redux Toolkit for state management with proper typing
- Follow React functional component patterns with hooks
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling with consistent design tokens
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Use React Router for navigation

### Backend (.NET Core)
- Follow RESTful API conventions
- Use Entity Framework Core for data access
- Implement proper validation and error handling
- Use dependency injection
- Follow SOLID principles
- Implement proper authentication and authorization

### General
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add proper comments for complex logic
- Implement responsive design
- Follow accessibility best practices
- Use proper error boundaries and validation
